why: Done: Intro to Blender lesson 10 passes when "A PNG render is saved next to the .blend file". The learner rendered (F12) and used Image > Save As, keeping Blender's default name untitled.png in the mug's folder. That is a PNG render next to mug.blend; the step never asked for a file name.

step.title: Render and save an image
step.instructions: Render the mug with F12, then in the render window choose Image > Save As and save it as a PNG next to mug.blend.
